phase_basis: R2 manufacturer verification; architecture candidates, not schematic values

IM73A135V01.board_role: four external analog microphones feeding Board A

TAS5825M.board_role: Board B stereo BTL digital-input amplifier

hard_constraints: No nominal 3.3 V on IM73A135 VDD; 3.0 V absolute maximum.
Direct microphone-to-ADC load is unapproved: ADC maximum input impedance 20 kohm per pin versus microphone minimum load 25 kohm per output.
Four analog ADC channels at 96 kHz require DRE/AGC disabled per E-ADC-RATE Figure 3-3.
Board B amplifier needs no forwarded MCLK in the candidate 3-wire mode.
Independent hardware path must force amplifier safe state; MCU watchdog reset alone does not prove it.
open_for_r3_r4: exact RT1062 MPN/silicon/pin mux/audio clock roots and boot model
mic AFE including harness capacitance, loading, gain, noise and low-frequency phase
clock edge/setup/hold, DMA/cache and complete ANC latency
external flash size/MPN and boot image budget
external watchdog, amp fault/power-good/safe-state polarity and timing
protected input, 5 V buck and all rail budgets
12 V amplifier headroom, output filter and thermal proof
